We define the work before we start building

Bring a need to explore, a design ready to implement or a solution already in use. We agree on what needs solving and which service will move you forward from there.

Tell us where you are todayView ways of working

What we agree on before starting

Scope and priorities

What we will solve, what comes later and what information we need to start.

Deliverables and validation

What your team receives and the criteria used to check it meets the agreement.

Budget and responsibilities

The budget, schedule and what each party must contribute to deliver the agreed outcome.

Choose the service your project needs

Audit, design, implementation and support can be engaged separately. You don't need all four: we review what is already defined and agree on the work you need.

Choose what to address first

What we do

We review the process, tools and constraints your team faces. We compare configuring, connecting or building and prioritize a need with a concrete scope.

How your team participates

Your team shares how it works today, provides examples and identifies delays, errors or manual tasks. We need to understand both typical workflows and exceptions.

What you receive

An assessment with alternatives, priorities and a reasoned recommendation to decide the next step.

Agree on how the solution should work

What we do

We define users, workflows, rules, data and systems. We scope an initial version and acceptance criteria; depending on the project, documentation may include screens, flows or exchanges between tools.

How your team participates

Your team validates rules, reviews proposed workflows and helps decide what the first version must include. One person coordinates business decisions.

What you receive

Documented design and scope, with clear criteria to continue implementation with Cloudfianz or another team.

Build, test and launch

What we do

We build or configure the agreed solution and test it with representative situations. We review rules, permissions, integrations and exceptions with the people who know the operation before delivery.

How your team participates

Your team provides the agreed data and access, tests workflows and confirms acceptance criteria at the project's defined review points.

What you receive

The agreed solution, with testing and documentation. The proposal defines the code, configurations and access to be transferred, together with a handover to the people who will operate it.

Support the solution in operation

What we do

We handle incidents, maintenance and minor adjustments with agreed monthly capacity. We review needs arising from daily use and distinguish support work from requests requiring new scope.

How your team participates

Your team reports incidents with context, helps prioritize and validates adjustments. New features are assessed and quoted before being included.

What you receive

Service and maintenance within the contracted capacity, with tracking of the agreed work.

Frequently asked questions

Do we need to engage all four services?

No. Each service can be engaged separately, with its own deliverables and terms. If the need and solution are sufficiently defined, we can assess implementation directly. We can also support an existing solution.

Can you work from a design we already have?

Yes, after reviewing the materials. We assess whether workflows, rules, data and acceptance criteria are sufficient to agree on implementation. We identify any missing definitions before quoting that work.

What participation is needed from our team?

Someone who knows the process and can coordinate decisions, plus those who must validate the solution's use. We agree on review points and the information or access each party provides; not everyone needs to participate in the same way.

Can we continue with another team after delivery?

The design is documented to support that continuity. For implementation, the proposal specifies the code, configurations and access to be transferred, along with third-party licenses and components.
